mapper.select: SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.faq.mapper.selectFaqDetail */ A.faq_sn AS faqSn , A.task_se_cd AS taskSeCd , A.faq_clsf_nm AS faqClsfNm , A.faq_ttl AS faqTtl , A.faq_seq AS faqSeq , A.use_yn AS useYn , A.lang_se_cd AS langSeId , A.faq_ans_cn AS faqAnsCn , A.atch_file_id AS atchFileId , A.wrtr_dept_nm AS wrtrDeptNm , A.mdfr_dept_nm AS mdfrDeptNm , COALESCE(E.emp_nm, A.rgtr_id) AS rgtrId , TO_CHAR(A.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDt , A.mdfr_id AS mdfrId , TO_CHAR(A.mdfcn_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mdfcnDt , COALESCE(A.pst_inq_cnt, 0) AS pstInqCnt , A.faq_se_cd AS faqSeCd , C.com_dtl_cd_nm AS faqSeNm FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_faq A LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_mngr_info M ON M.emp_no = A.rgtr_id LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info E ON E.emp_no = M.emp_no LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_ca_c_dtl_code C ON C.com_dtl_cd = A.faq_se_cd AND C.com_group_cd = 'CMCMM00005' WHERE A.faq_sn = #{faqSn}
mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('kids_own.sq_cm_faq_sn')
/* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.faq.mapper.insertFaq */ INSERT INTO kids_own.tb_cm_m_faq ( faq_sn , task_se_cd , faq_clsf_nm , faq_ttl , faq_seq , use_yn , lang_se_cd , faq_ans_cn , atch_file_id , pst_inq_cnt , wrtr_dept_nm , mdfr_dept_nm , rgtr_id , reg_dt , mdfr_id , mdfcn_dt , faq_se_cd ) VALUES ( #{faqSn} , COALESCE(#{taskSeCd}, 'CDM') , (SELECT com_dtl_cd_nm FROM kids_own.tb_ca_c_dtl_code WHERE com_dtl_cd = #{faqSeCd} AND com_group_cd = 'CMCMM00005') , #{faqTtl} , COALESCE(#{faqSeq}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(faq_seq), 0) + 1 FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_faq)) , COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y') , COALESCE(#{langSeId}, 'ko') , #{faqAnsCn} , #{atchFileId} , COALESCE(#{pstInqCnt}, 0) , #{wrtrDeptNm} , #{mdfrDeptNm} , COALESCE(#{rgtrId}, '관리자') , NOW() , COALESCE(#{mdfrId}, '관리자') , NOW() , #{faqSeCd} )

faq_clsf_nm = (SELECT com_dtl_cd_nm FROM kids_own.tb_ca_c_dtl_code WHERE com_dtl_cd = #{faqSeCd} AND com_group_cd = 'CMCMM00005'),
faq_ttl = #{faqTtl},
faq_seq = #{faqSeq},

faq_ans_cn = #{faqAnsCn},
atch_file_id = #{atchFileId},
mdfr_dept_nm = #{mdfrDeptNm},

WHERE faq_sn = #{faqSn}
